item: Row B of the 0.4 gate closed on instance 090243's 72-hour run (R113, answered 17a); row A gains the 16-instance diagnostics' field evidence
summary: The maintainer's 2026-10-01 answer 17a: row B (the 72 h collector soak) closes on instance 090243's run of 19 to 22 September, its 73 hourly heartbeats as the memory evidence (the built-in memory check keeps about two hours). The gate records what the close does not claim: soak-window.json's reaches_bar being the later process's (the run's own soak-window block, taken by the soak process, reads 80.46 h), that process's 76 memory-guard engagements, which process 'ended cleanly' reads, and why 085214 (climbing), 085218 (final report never written) and 085230 (30 h) do not close it. Row A stays open with its bar unchanged and now records inversions-found on two instances (three named domains), the merge fix on main (PR #1278, unit-proved, its field proof is this row's), the two import shapes that still arrive inverted (a row holding the instance's own measured verdict beside a newer, disagreeing incoming attempt, and a backup from an instance that is itself inverted; both reproduced with the real merge, no test covers either), and scripts/repair_qualification_inversions.py, on main since 2026-09-12 (PR #1117) and named in no gate file until now. It also corrects a date: no release run started on 2026-09-26, the eight runs in the bundles all started on 2026-09-19 (085218 and 085230 armed their soaks on the 26th, after resumes on the 22nd). Docs only.
